sentences.text: In terms of the order passed by this Court on 16.01.2026, charge sheet as well as the statement of the Complainant and other witnesses recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. have been submitted.
2. Drawing the attention of this Court to the charge sheet, it is submitted that ex facie on the basis of the materials on record the complicity of the Petitioner is not established.
Hence, learned Court in seisin has acted with material irregularity in framing the charge under Sections 419/420 IPC read with Sections 66C/66D of the I.T Act.

3. On perusal of the charge sheet and the statements on record, this Court is persuaded to hold that the matter merits consideration.
4.
Issue notice to the Opposite Parties.
5. Since learned counsel for the State accepts notice on behalf of Opposite Party No.1, no notice need be issued.
6. Notice to Opposite Party No.2 be issued by Speed Post.

Learned counsel for the State is requested to obtain the case diary as well as the instructions as to whether any intimation has been received which was sought from MB Credit Information Bureau Ltd., Mumbai in respect of the loan which has been sanctioned and cleared relating to the Petitioner and the Opposite Party No.2 in the meanwhile.
